notes.title: Reality's Reversу Side is Now Available on Steam!
notes.notes: Reality's reverse side is a quite unusual novel about an ordinary detective who has no cases for a long time. But one day everything changes and Stefan (that's the name of the main character) gets a new case, and a new life together with it, full of interesting, and sometimes very dangerous adventures. Do vampires exist? What is Zhonki hiding? Should you marry Cutie Hugh? Will Stefan be able to return to his former place of work? Or will he decide to stay? Or maybe he... will die? Well, you can find the answers to all these questions right now!
